items.title: 27.5.3 Jeneyati code aur protein ki tayyari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the genetic code and protein synthesis (PDF 174).

blocks.text: Protein ki tayyari DNA mein code shuda jeneyati maloomat ko proteins mein muntaqil karti hai. Yeh replication, yani DNA ki naqlein banane, se shuru hoti hai. Nucleus mein protein banane ki jeneyati hidayaat DNA ke gene se mRNA mein copy hoti hain: yeh transcription hai. Mukammal mRNA dhaaga DNA chhor kar cytoplasm mein jata aur ribosomes se jurta hai. Ribosomes par mRNA ka code parha aur amino acids ki khaas tarteeb mein badla jata hai: yeh translation hai. tRNA molecules mRNA ke bases (codons, teen bases ke groups) ki tarteeb se amino acids late hain, amino acids zanjeer mein jurte hain, aur barhti polypeptide mukammal protein ban jati hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar se neeche: DNA se wapas DNA tak ghoomta teer, replication (DNA se DNA), DNA polymerase; DNA (do dhaage); teer transcription (DNA se RNA), RNA polymerase; RNA (aik dhaaga); teer translation (RNA se protein), ribosome; aur motiyon ki lari ki shakal mein protein.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.17: Protein ki tayyari (kitab ki Figure 27.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Replication ka ghoomta teer DNA se wapas DNA par aata hai: DNA ki naql. Transcription nucleus mein DNA se RNA banati hai, aur translation cytoplasm mein ribosomes par RNA ke code se amino acids ki lari (protein) banati hai.

blocks.prompt: Shakar-phosphate reerh aur base pairing se milne wale istehkaam ka muqabla karein, A aur T aur G aur C ke darmiyan bonds ke hawale se.
blocks.explanation: Reerh mazboot covalent phosphodiester bonds se thami hai, is liye har dhaaga bohat mustahkam hai. Dhaage sirf bases ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se jure hain, har A-T jore mein do aur G-C mein teen; har aik kamzor hai, is liye dhaage naqal ke liye alag ho sakte, lekin lakhon mil kar double helix ko mazbooti se thaamte hain, aur G-C wale hisse zyada mustahkam hain.

blocks.prompt: DNA aur RNA kimiyai taur par kaise mukhtalif aur kaise milte julte hain?
blocks.explanation: Farq: DNA mein deoxyribose aur thymine aur yeh dohra dhaaga hai; RNA mein ribose aur uracil aur yeh aam taur par akela dhaaga hai. Mushabehat: dono phosphodiester links se jure nucleotides (phosphate, paanch carbon shakar, base) ke polymers hain, aur dono mein A, G aur C hain.

blocks.prompt: Taqreeban har cell mein wahi 23 jore chromosomes hain, phir bhi khoon ka surkh cell haemoglobin aur jild ka cell keratin banata hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif cells mukhtalif genes chalu karte hain: banta hua surkh cell haemoglobin ka gene transcribe karta, jab ke jild ka cell keratin ka gene; baqi genes band rehte hain.

items: Replication DNA ki naqal; transcription nucleus mein mRNA banati.
Ribosomes par translation: tRNA codons se mil kar amino acids ko protein mein jorta.
